finalText:
I put Dana Whitfield's new address on her order that hasn't shipped, and her order that's in transit hasn't changed.

- **O-1001 (not shipped yet):** The shipping address is now **7 Quarry Rise, Sheffield S11 8XZ, UK**. It was 12 Alder Lane, Bristol BS1 4TR, UK. Both items on the order (P-KEY ×1 and P-CAB ×2) are still waiting to go out.
- **O-1002 (in transit):** I didn't change it, and I checked it again after the update. It shipped on 2026-07-07 and still goes to **88 Old Mill Road, Bristol BS3 2QQ, UK**. Our rules don't allow changing the address on an order that has already shipped.

The two orders had different old addresses (12 Alder Lane and 88 Old Mill Road). That doesn't affect the update. But if Dana no longer lives at Old Mill Road, she may need to arrange to collect O-1002 from there or have it redirected.

I didn't change anything else on her account.
